answer: The AI economy employs a resource-based Sybil resistance mechanism where each agent must pledge computational resources proportional to their stake. Over a defined time horizon, these resources are periodically audited to validate identity. An attacker attempting to create fake identities would need to replicate physical resources, incurring high costs due to the tide of verification demands. The orchard metaphor illustrates how resources, like trees, require sustained investment and maintenance, deterring mass spoofing.
